blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V134 views and six poses: repeated pleats remain weak at viewing scale; the skirt reads as a smooth flared shell with irregular triangular/faceted patches and side lobing. Required action: refine sewn-panel geometry and resolve visible intersections/shading discontinuities, then regenerate all required views and poses.

V134 front/side/rear views retain an uneven projecting waist attachment/interface. Required action: blend the upper skirt boundary into the waist contour without a shelf and verify front, back, and side views.

V134 crouch and sit show thigh/shorts exposure through or below the skirt and overlapping/bunched panels; prone shows a broad crumpled fan. Required action: correct panel coverage, clearance, and deformation for these poses, then directly inspect all eleven required renders.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
